description.ar: صمم نظام دفع مع ledger وidempotency وتكامل PSP
description.en: Design a payment system with ledger, idempotency, and PSP integration

problemStatement.ar: صمم نظام مدفوعات لتطبيق تجارة. لازم authorize/capture، منع double-charge، ledger للمحاسبة، وrefunds. افترض تكامل مع PSP خارجي.
problemStatement.en: Design a payments system for a commerce app. Need authorize/capture, no double-charge, an accounting ledger, and refunds. Assume an external PSP integration.

prompt.ar: قبل التصميم: اسأل عن الـ scope واعمل حسبة.
prompt.en: Before designing: clarify scope and estimate.

text.en: Asked about payment methods and authorize/capture

ar.mistakes: خطأ: تفترض charge واحد sync وخلاص.

en.mistakes: Mistake: assuming one sync charge and done.

text.ar: قدّرت TPS للـ authorize وpeak sales events
text.en: Estimated authorize TPS and peak sales events

ar.tradeoffs: Payment TPS أقل من browse بس أحرج.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: sizing من average اليومي بس.

en.tradeoffs: Payment TPS is lower than browse but more critical.
en.mistakes: Mistake: sizing from daily average only.

text.ar: وضّحت consistency: مفيش double charge أبدًا
text.en: Clarified consistency: never double charge

ar.how: Idempotency key من العميل + ledger unique constraints.
ar.tradeoffs: Exactly-once عبر الشبكة مستحيل؛ exactly-once effect ممكن.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تقول 2PC على PSP خارجي.

en.why: This is the system's strongest constraint.
en.how: Client idempotency key + ledger unique constraints.
en.tradeoffs: Exactly-once over the network is impossible; exactly-once effect is possible.
en.mistakes: Mistake: proposing 2PC with an external PSP.

text.en: Asked about ledger requirements and audit

ar.tradeoffs: Mutable balances من غير journal خطر.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: UPDATE balance in place من غير journal.

en.why: Accounting is not just an order row.
en.tradeoffs: Mutable balances without a journal are dangerous.
en.mistakes: Mistake: UPDATE balance in place without a journal.

prompt.ar: اوصف ledger، PSP integration، idempotency، وoutbox/saga.
prompt.en: Describe ledger, PSP integration, idempotency, and outbox/saga.

text.ar: 📊 Client → LB → API → Ledger DB + Queue/Outbox → PSP + Worker
text.en: 📊 Client → LB → API → Ledger DB + Queue/Outbox → PSP + Worker

ar.why: فصل قرار الدفع عن التكامل الخارجي.
ar.how: API يكتب intent + outbox. Worker يكلّم PSP ويحدّث الحالة.
ar.tradeoffs: Sync PSP أبسط وأهش تحت الـ timeout.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: charge في الـ request من غير idempotency store.

en.why: Decouple payment decision from external integration.
en.how: API writes intent + outbox. Worker calls PSP and updates state.
en.tradeoffs: Sync PSP is simpler and more fragile under timeouts.
en.mistakes: Mistake: charging in-request without an idempotency store.

text.ar: Idempotency keys مع تخزين الرد الأول
text.en: Idempotency keys storing the first response

ar.how: Key → request hash + response. Conflict لو body مختلف.
ar.tradeoffs: TTL للـ keys بعد اكتمال آمن.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتمد على client وحده من غير server store.

en.how: Key → request hash + response. Conflict if body differs.
en.mistakes: Mistake: relying on the client alone without a server store.

text.en: Double-entry ledger: immutable journal entries

ar.mistakes: خطأ: تطبق saga من غير ledger append.

en.how: Every movement = debit/credit. Balances as views/materialized.
en.mistakes: Mistake: applying saga without ledger append.

text.ar: Saga/orchestration للـ capture/refund؛ مش 2PC عبر PSP
text.en: Saga/orchestration for capture/refund; not 2PC across PSP

ar.mistakes: خطأ: distributed 2PC على خدمات خارجية.

en.why: PSP is outside your transaction boundary.
en.mistakes: Mistake: distributed 2PC across external services.

prompt.ar: إزاي تـ scale مع double-entry ledger وhot merchants؟
prompt.en: How do you scale with a double-entry ledger and hot merchants?

text.en: Shard ledger by account/merchant id

ar.mistakes: خطأ: ledger واحد global lock.

en.why: A hot merchant can saturate the DB.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one global ledger lock.

text.en: PSP connection pools + regional endpoints

ar.mistakes: خطأ: unlimited parallel authorize.

en.mistakes: Mistake: unlimited parallel authorize.

text.ar: Read replicas للـ reporting مش للـ authorize path
text.en: Read replicas for reporting not authorize path

ar.mistakes: خطأ: authorize على replica.

en.mistakes: Mistake: authorizing against a replica.

prompt.ar: SLIs: authorize p99، reconcile lag، chargeback rate.
prompt.en: SLIs: authorize p99, reconcile lag, chargeback rate.

text.ar: SLO: authorize p99 < 1s، success rate عالية
text.en: SLO: authorize p99 < 1s, high success rate

ar.mistakes: خطأ: متوسط latency يخفي PSP واحد وحش.

en.mistakes: Mistake: average latency hiding one bad PSP.

text.en: Reconcile lag and imbalance alerts

ar.why: الفلوس لازم تتطابق مع PSP reports.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: reconcile يدوي أسبوعي بس.

en.mistakes: Mistake: only weekly manual reconcile.

text.en: Fraud score / velocity alerts

ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش velocity caps.

en.mistakes: Mistake: no velocity caps.

prompt.ar: PSP outages، duplicate charges، ledger imbalance.
prompt.en: PSP outages, duplicate charges, ledger imbalance.

text.en: PSP outage or latency spike

ar.how: Failover PSP، queue captures، clear UX.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: يوزر يشوف spinner من غير حالة.

en.how: Failover PSP, queue captures, clear UX.
en.mistakes: Mistake: user sees a spinner with no state.

text.en: Duplicate charge from retries

ar.tradeoffs: Over-strict keys ممكن تمنع retries شرعية.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: retry POST من غير key.

en.tradeoffs: Over-strict keys can block legit retries.
en.mistakes: Mistake: retrying POST without a key.

text.ar: Hot merchant flash sale lock contention
text.en: Hot merchant flash sale lock contention

ar.how: Per-intent rows، avoid single balance row hotspot، queue.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: SELECT FOR UPDATE على merchant balance لكل الدفعات.

en.how: Per-intent rows, avoid single balance-row hotspot, queue.
en.mistakes: Mistake: SELECT FOR UPDATE on merchant balance for every payment.

prompt.en: Saga vs 2PC, and authorization vs capture.

text.en: Saga vs 2PC

ar.mistakes: خطأ: 2PC كجواب افتراضي في المقابلة.

en.tradeoffs: 2PC is rare and not with PSPs.
en.mistakes: Mistake: 2PC as the default interview answer.

text.en: Separate auth+capture vs single sale

ar.how: Auth+capture للـ inventory hold. Sale للـ digital الفوري.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: capture فوري قبل تأكيد المخزون.

en.how: Auth+capture for inventory hold. Sale for instant digital.
en.mistakes: Mistake: immediate capture before inventory confirmation.

text.ar: In-house ledger vs PSP as source of truth
text.en: In-house ledger vs PSP as source of truth

ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتمد على PSP dashboard كـ SoT وحيد.

en.how: Internal ledger is required for wallets/marketplaces.
en.tradeoffs: Internal ledger is a heavy responsibility.
en.mistakes: Mistake: relying on PSP dashboard as sole SoT.

text.en: Refunds and partial capture

ar.how: New ledger entries، مش تعديل قديم. Link to original.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: DELETE/UPDATE لحركة مالية قديمة.

en.how: New ledger entries, not editing old ones. Link to original.
en.mistakes: Mistake: DELETE/UPDATE of an old money movement.

text.en: Practical exactly-once effect

ar.why: مهم توضح الفرق عن network exactly-once.
ar.tradeoffs: مش سهل عبر كل الأنظمة الخارجية.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعد exactly-once من غير آلية.

en.why: Important to distinguish from network exactly-once.
en.tradeoffs: Not easy across all external systems.
en.mistakes: Mistake: promising exactly-once with no mechanism.

text.en: Multi-currency and FX fees

ar.how: لا تخلط العملات في حساب واحد.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: float واحد لكل العملات.

en.how: Do not mix currencies in one account.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one float for all currencies.

text.en: PSP fees >> infra usually

ar.why: الـ take rate هو البند الأكبر.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تركّز على EC2 وتنسى fees.

en.why: Take rate is the biggest line item.
en.how: Estimate GMV × fee. Infra is secondary.
en.tradeoffs: Routing to cheaper PSP increases risk.
en.mistakes: Mistake: focusing on EC2 and forgetting fees.

text.en: Idempotency/ledger storage grows with payments

ar.mistakes: خطأ: جدول واحد بلا نهاية.

en.mistakes: Mistake: one endless table.

text.ar: Fraud tools تكلفة vs chargeback savings
text.en: Fraud tools cost vs chargeback savings

ar.how: Measure prevented loss vs false-positive lost sales.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: 3DS على كل عملية صغيرة.

en.how: Measure prevented loss vs false-positive lost sales.
en.mistakes: Mistake: 3DS on every tiny payment.

text.ar: قلّل PCI scope عبر tokenization/PSP elements
text.en: Reduce PCI scope via tokenization/PSP elements

ar.how: Hosted fields / token vault. متخزنش PAN.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن أرقام كروت في DB التطبيق.

en.how: Hosted fields / token vault. Do not store PAN.
en.tradeoffs: In-house card data rarely worth it.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing card numbers in the app DB.

text.en: HSM/KMS for secrets and webhook signing

ar.mistakes: خطأ: webhook من غير signature check.

en.mistakes: Mistake: webhook without signature check.

text.ar: Least privilege بين order وpayment وledger
text.en: Least privilege between order, payment, and ledger

ar.mistakes: خطأ: خدمة واحدة تقدر تعمل refund بلا قيود.

en.mistakes: Mistake: one service able to refund without constraints.

text.ar: RPO≈0 للـ ledger عبر sync replication
text.en: Near-zero RPO for ledger via sync replication

ar.mistakes: خطأ: async فقط على ledger من غير قبول المخاطر.

en.mistakes: Mistake: async-only ledger without accepting the risk.

text.ar: Runbook: PSP down → queue & reconcile later
text.en: Runbook: PSP down → queue & reconcile later

ar.how: Accept intents، delayed capture، customer messaging.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تفشل الطلب من غير حفظ intent.

en.how: Accept intents, delayed capture, customer messaging.
en.mistakes: Mistake: failing the order without saving intent.

text.en: GameDay: replay webhooks and idempotent apply

ar.mistakes: خطأ: أول replay في حادثة حقيقية يكرر capture.

en.mistakes: Mistake: first replay in a real incident double-captures.

rangeHint.en: A response record is usually hundreds of bytes.
A compact ledger entry is often 150–600 bytes.

steps.ar: 2) GMV = intents × ticket؛ fees = GMV × fee%.
steps.en: 2) GMV = intents × ticket; fees = GMV × fee%.

steps.ar: 3) Storage من idempotency retention وledger entries.
steps.en: 3) Storage from idempotency retention and ledger entries.

description.ar: نصف طلبات الـ authorize بتـ timeout. مش عارفين اتخصم ولا لأ.
description.en: Half of authorize calls time out. Unclear whether charged.

checklist.ar: لا تعمل charge جديد — استعلم بالـ idempotency/PSP id
checklist.en: Do not create a new charge — query by idempotency/PSP id

description.ar: Reconcile لقى فرق بين مجموع القيود وتقرير PSP.
description.en: Reconcile found a gap between ledger totals and PSP report.

expectedNote.ar: Saga هي الإجابة الصحيحة عبر PSP/services.
expectedNote.en: Saga is the right answer across PSP/services.

consB.en: Does not work with external PSP

whenOtherWins.ar: 2PC فقط داخل نظام مغلق نادرًا ما يظهر هنا.
whenOtherWins.en: 2PC only inside a closed system, rarely applicable here.

question.ar: Sale فوري ولا auth ثم capture؟
question.en: Immediate sale or auth then capture?

whenOtherWins.en: Immediate sale for instant digital goods.

caption.en: Worker calls PSP and records result

caption.ar: Idempotent replay لنفس المفتاح يرجع نفس الرد
caption.en: Idempotent replay of same key returns same response
Ledger is source for money state

caption.ar: لا تكرر charge — افحص idem/ledger أولًا
caption.en: Do not double charge — check idem/ledger first
